response: Vitamin D supplementation has been shown to have a positive effect on regulatory T cells in apparently healthy subjects. Regulatory T cells play a crucial role in maintaining immune tolerance and preventing autoimmune diseases. Research suggests that vitamin D treatment can increase the number and function of regulatory T cells, which may help to prevent or alleviate autoimmune diseases such as multiple sclerosis, type 1 diabetes, and rheumatoid arthritis. Therefore, vitamin D supplementation may be a potential treatment option for autoimmune diseases, although more research is needed to confirm its effectiveness.
